method: Built-in image_gen for the two photographic reconstructions; deterministic vector generation for masks and finish layers.
notice: Simulação reconstruída a partir de uma imagem de baixa resolução. Não é uma fotografia técnica nem certifica o acabamento de outros tamanhos. As dimensões reais de segurança, sangria e corte continuam sendo as cadastradas no produto.

prompts.front: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: reusable FRONT base layer for an ecommerce personalized round pinback button mockup. Input image is a reference for the actual small round 25 mm pinback button with a rolled glossy printed front and silver metal rear pin. Create ONE isolated front-facing blank button, not the two overlapping buttons of the reference. Perfectly straight-on orthographic view, perfectly circular, centered at the exact canvas center; the button diameter must occupy exactly 80 percent of a square canvas (10 percent transparent margin on each side). Clean neutral white printable front, subtle photorealistic convex rounded edge and tiny natural rim. REMOVE all existing lettering, logos, colored art and numbers. Do not retain 'Sua Arte Aqui' or Ground Shop. Preserve the real button construction and realistic material, but this is a reconstruction from the low resolution reference, not a new kind of pin. Soft studio light upper left. Actual transparent background and transparent corners, no floor, no rectangular background, no cast shadow outside the button. No text, labels, watermark, diagrams or other items. Output a square high-resolution PNG with alpha, ideally 1024 by 1024.
prompts.back: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: BACK base layer of a reusable round 25mm pinback button mockup. The input photo is the product reference, showing its silver rear face and horizontal safety pin, partly hidden by the foreground front button. Reconstruct ONLY the complete back face, separately, faithfully preserving that simple silver metal inset disc, rolled circular rim, horizontal safety-pin wire and two small clasps. Remove all lettering and colored Ground Shop logo, leaving unbranded neutral brushed silver steel. Perfect straight-on orthographic camera, perfect circle, centered exactly at 50 percent horizontal and vertical in a square canvas. Whole outer button circle diameter 80 percent of canvas, with exact 10 percent transparent margins all four sides. Soft studio lighting upper left. Crisp, carefully defined smooth silhouette. Real transparent background with alpha, no floor, no black/white rectangle, no external shadow, no second object, no perspective tilt, no labels or typography. Photorealistic pin hardware, realistic slight reflection. PNG square ideally1024x1024.
